title: AGENT-BASED MODEL OF INITIAL TOKEN ALLOCATIONS: EVALUATING WEALTH CONCENTRATION IN FAIR LAUNCHES
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its findings focus on the dynamics of wealth concentration in tokenized systems, concluding that regardless of the initial 'fair' allocation method, token tradability inherently leads to concentration over time.
